text: Leah is having a housewarming on Saturday 14 June at the new flat in Leith. Remind me to pick up a plant for her on the way.
Khadija told me at lunch that she's pregnant! Due in early March. She's been really sick in the mornings and is exhausted, poor thing.
Caroline and Graham have invited us to their 25th anniversary dinner on the 3rd of August. Smart dress, apparently.
Mandla is obsessed with Kaizer Chiefs. He watches every match at 6am on his laptop.
Marcus's wedding party is off. He and Jada split up last week. I should give Marc a ring this weekend and see how he's holding up.
Need to buy milk, bin bags and a birthday card on the way home.
Eilidh's baby girl arrived on Tuesday! Her name is Isla, 7lb 2oz. Mother and baby both doing well.

Tadhg has started learning the fiddle after years of saying he would. He's doing lessons with an old fella in Galway over Zoom on Tuesday nights and practises every evening, mostly reels and jigs. His neighbours have already complained twice. He wants to play a session at the pub by Christmas, which feels ambitious.

Had coffee with Abebe. His wife Selam is expecting their second in November, and he's quietly panicking about space in the flat. They're looking at three-beds in Walthamstow but nothing's come up yet. Don't forget to send him that link to the house on Elm Road.
Kavya's christening for little Arjun is on Sunday 22nd September at St Mary's, lunch afterwards at her mum's. I'm doing a salad for it.
Rafael plays five-a-side on Thursdays and supports Benfica. Hates Porto with a passion.

Rohan's 40th is next Friday at the Crown, upstairs room from 7. His partner Uma is organising it and says it's not a surprise, but he doesn't know about the band. She said he'd love anything to do with vinyl. He's been hunting for an original pressing of Kind of Blue for ages. Remind me to check the record shop on Broad Street on Wednesday.
Valentina rang. The dinner party she was planning for tomorrow is cancelled because her son has chickenpox. We'll try again in a fortnight.
Nia knits constantly. She's making a blanket for her sister's baby, due on 14/05, and she's only halfway through.
Remind me to ask Joe how the gig went on Saturday. He was really nervous about singing the solo.
Matilda's cat Pickle went missing on Monday. She's put posters up all over the village and is beside herself.

Jamal invited me to his book club. They meet the first Wednesday of every month at someone's house and take turns choosing. They're reading Piranesi at the moment, and next is something by Ishiguro. Jamal is very serious about it and keeps a spreadsheet of everything they've read since 2019, with scores out of ten. He says the wine is the real draw for most people.
Uma said her brother Rohan and his wife are hosting Diwali dinner this year, on the 1st of November. She's a bit stressed because she's doing all the sweets.
Elijah is training for the Great North Run in September. Wants to break two hours. He's also gluten free, so remember that if we have him over.
Bao's baby shower is on 9 March at Thomas's house. We're all chipping in for the pram. I need to transfer Thomas £30 by Friday.
Booked the dentist for next Tuesday at 9.
Camila and Emre are getting their son Deniz christened on the 12th of October. They've asked me to be godparent! Must find out what a godparent actually has to do.
Florin builds model railways in his garage. He's spent about ten years on a layout of Brașov station and still isn't finished.

Kiara is really struggling with the twins. Neither of them sleeps more than two hours at a time and her husband is away for work until the 30th. I should drop a lasagne round tomorrow evening and offer to take them for a walk on the weekend so she can nap.

Asha and her husband Kwame had their gender reveal yesterday. It's a boy! Their dog Mabel was very confused by the confetti and spent the rest of the afternoon hiding under the table. Asha is due on 19 February, and her mum is flying in from Accra the week before to help. She's already planning the nursery in green and yellow.
Irina's leaving do is next Thursday at the Italian place on Queen Street. She retires after 32 years at the library.

Patrick mentioned at the club that he's been dropping hints about a new set of golf irons for his birthday, but his wife Jada thinks he has enough clubs already. His birthday is 28 July. He plays off a twelve handicap and is desperate to get to single figures this season. Maybe a lesson voucher instead.
Graham has a huge collection of Tottenham programmes going back to the seventies. Keeps them in plastic sleeves in the loft.
Don't forget to RSVP to Adriana's engagement party by Monday. It's on Saturday the 18th.
Leah is pregnant again! Only ten weeks, so she hasn't told work yet. Her first scan is on the 2nd of December. Remind me to text her that morning.
Spoke to Khadija on the phone. Her husband Imran is planning a surprise 30th for her on 6 April. I'm sworn to secrecy and need to send him the photos of us at uni.
Caroline loves crossword puzzles and does the Guardian cryptic every day. She's terrible at sudoku though.

Mandla's daughter Zola starts nursery on Monday and he's dreading it more than she is. He's taken the morning off so he can do the drop-off, then he's going straight to the gym to distract himself. His wife Thandi is doing pick-up. He said Zola already has a backpack shaped like a ladybird and refuses to take it off, even at bedtime. Should text Mandla on Monday lunchtime to see how drop-off went.
Marcus is into bouldering now. He goes three times a week and has a trip to Fontainebleau planned for May.
Eilidh's parents are flying over from Inverness on Friday to meet the baby. They're staying a fortnight.
Tadhg and his girlfriend Nia are having a barbecue this Sunday. I'm bringing the burgers and some beers.
Thinking about doing a pottery class in the new year. The one in Hackney runs on Wednesday evenings.
Abebe's christening party for baby Liya was lovely. Remember to send Selam the photos I took, and post the card I forgot to give them.
Kavya is a huge Taylor Swift fan and has tickets for Wembley on the 21st of June. She's going with her cousin Priya.
Rafael's wife Ana gave birth on Sunday night! A little boy, Tomás. Need to sort a present. Maybe a babygrow in Benfica colours.
Rohan is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Good to know for the dinner on Saturday.
Valentina's mum is turning 70 on the 5th of May. Val is throwing her a big lunch and wants me to bake the cake.
Nia's brother Elijah is moving to Glasgow next month. She's gutted.
Joe has invited everyone to his housewarming on the 30th. The address is 14 Park Lane, flat 3. Bring a bottle.
Quiet one tonight. Cooked, read a few chapters, early bed.
Matilda's daughter Rosie has her first ballet recital on Saturday afternoon. Matilda is more nervous than Rosie.
Jamal and his wife are expecting! Twins, due in late January. He looked shell-shocked. Remind me to check in with him next week once it's sunk in.
Uma plays the cello in an amateur orchestra. Their winter concert is on 13 December at the town hall. I said I'd go.

Long call with Elijah. His sister Bao is having a tough pregnancy, lots of hospital visits, and their mum has gone down to help. He's worried. Bao's next scan is on Thursday. He also said he's finally got into the Sunday league team he trialled for, which is brilliant. I should message Bao on Thursday evening to see how the scan went.
Thomas collects vintage Polaroid cameras. He has about forty and wants a SX-70 next.
Camila had to cancel the girls' dinner on Friday because the baby has a cold. Rescheduled to next Friday instead.
Emre's dad had a fall and is in hospital. Emre is visiting him every day after work and is shattered.
Florin is hosting a games night on Saturday the 9th. He's really into Gloomhaven at the moment and wants to start a campaign. I should get there early to help set up.
Kiara's baby Amara is being christened on 15 June. Kiara asked if I'd do a reading. I'm nervous about it already.
Remind me to ask Asha how her antenatal class went last night.

Irina loves crime novels, especially anything Scandinavian. She's read every Jo Nesbø book twice. Her granddaughter Sofia is turning five on the 3rd of March and wants a unicorn party. Irina is making the cake herself and is slightly terrified.
Patrick and Jada are having a joint 50th party at the cricket club on 27 September. It's a 70s theme, so I need to find flares.
Got invited to the Morris family's Christmas drinks on the 20th. Graham said the whole street goes.
Adriana Lopez is now properly into sourdough. She's named her starter Gerald and feeds it twice a day.
Mrs Sato from next door had her granddaughter's naming ceremony yesterday. She showed me loads of photos over the fence. I must remember to take her some flowers tomorrow.
